changelog:
stuck-trace v0.1.0

- Initial release of the skill for structural root-cause tracing when users report being "stuck" in project, collaboration, or decision-related scenarios.
- Automatically adjusts output depth according to available user/agent files (SOUL.md, USER.md, memory), with clear fallback to "zero archive" mode based on just the current context.
- Produces concise, multi-block breakdowns showing cause chains, key decision points, alternative paths, and distilled reflections, always avoiding advice or judgment.
- Strict privacy boundaries: never surfaces sensitive numbers, real names, medical, financial, or private log content in outputs.
- Demo ("demo") and full-process workflow included; never fakes depth—transparently signals analytic limits if memory is missing.
summary: 当用户在和 AI 对话时陷入项目/协作/决策卡点(说"卡住了/推不动/帮我溯源"且明显在描述真实组织或项目困境)时触发。这个 skill 不靠用户重新讲一遍——读 agent 的 SOUL.md、USER.md、memory/ 和近期对话,从"你是谁、最近在扛什么、上次卡在哪"出发,输出根因链、关键分叉点、还能走...
